reason: I have an iPhone, so I can't even download it, and I'm not opening a website to snap a receipt. Even if it were on iPhone I'd use the free version for a week and forget about it, like I do with every other budgeting app.
objection: It's not on iPhone. And $6 a month is another Spotify-sized charge for something I'd stop opening after a week.
would_change_my_mind: An iPhone app, and then a free month that actually kept me opening it past week one.
